Type-1 Zoning Map Amendment

For 3611-25 N Halsted St, Chicago, IL 60613
From C1-2 to C1-5

1.A. The applicant seeks a zoning change from a C1-2 Neighborhood Commercial
District to those of a C1-5 Neighborhood Commercial District in preparation for
the filing of a planned development application. The proposed property will be a
12 story mixed-use property with 188 dwelling units, 38 of which will be
affordable, with 77 parking spaces and 188 bicycle parking spaces. There will be
909 square feet of commercial space on the ground floor and a proposed height of

137°-2”.
FAR 5.0 (142,146 sf)
Density (MLA) 151 (188 units)
Building Area 142,146 sf
Lot Area 28,429.3 sf
Building Height 137’-2” (underside roof joists at 12" floor)
Front Setback (West) 0’ (grade-2) / 10’-8” (tower 3-12)
Rear Setback (East) 0° (grade-2) / 5-0” (tower 3-12)
Side Setback (North) 0 (grade-2) / 17°71” (tower 3-12)
Side Setback (South) 0° (grade-2) / 12-1” (tower 3-12)
Parking 77 parking spaces / 188 bike spaces

ARO 20% (38 units)
